children: Homegrown diversified EPC player Kalpataru Projects International on Friday said its arm Linjemontage i Grastorp AB (LMG) has made its debut on Sweden's Nasdaq Stockholm.
With this, KPIL becomes the first Indian company to list its foreign subsidiary Linjemontage on Nasdaq Stockholm.

The IPO of its stepdown subsidiary LMG was priced at SEK 46 per equity share, equivalent to a valuation of SEK 2,357 million (about ₹2,282 crore), Kalpataru Projects International Ltd (KPIL) said in an exchange filing.
Post-listing, KPIL through Kalpataru Power Transmission Sweden AB (KPTS), a wholly-owned subsidiary, retains an approximately 65.9 per cent stake in LMG.
KPTS shall receive a gross consideration of SEK 711.5 million (including the Over-allotment option/green shoe option), subject to issue expenses, customary adjustments and set-offs.

Manish Mohnot, MD & CEO of KPIL, said: "The IPO validates LMG’s strong position as one of the leading EPC providers in the power infrastructure segment in Sweden and marks a significant step in unlocking value for KPIL's shareholders. As they transition into an independent publicly listed entity, we look forward to supporting LMG's continued journey."
Kalpataru Projects International Limited (KPIL) is a leading engineering and construction company in the power and infrastructure sector.

title: Kalpataru Projects Int'l lists subsidiary on Sweden's Nasdaq Stockholm
